g.text: Layer 1 · Subsystems, persisted state and their integration boundaries
Agents use API facts and a verified reference snapshot; tools do not actuate pumps.
Feast is an embedded SDK; DuckDB reads registered offline Parquet.
Boxes group logical subsystems; Layer 2 expands jobs/APIs and request returns.
Layer 3 locates workloads on CPU/GPU hosts, shared disks and private networks.
Solid: data or request dependency. Dashed: orchestration, release or secret sync.
Crossings do not join. Recorded lab; animated dots show direction, not live traffic.

g.aria-label: Illustrative flow directions; not live telemetry
